description: Liao Hua, sturdy veteran chinese soldier in the supplied pixel art style, green cloth head wrap with two short knot tails on his left side, grey hair, green hooded cape over brown lamellar armor with tan trim, tan trousers, dark boots, one curved single-edged saber in the right hand, left hand empty
face: Grey beard and thick grey eyebrows, stern eyes.
rear_detail: Seen from behind: the back of the green head wrap with grey hair under it, the knot tails on his left, and the green cape covering the back down to the calves.
guard_action: the right hand lifts the saber up in front of the body, the left hand stays free as a guard, the left foot steps forward and the knees bend

actions.idle: Fighting guard with a one-handed saber, breathing
actions.move: Seamless combat run in place, two alternating steps over 15 frames, carrying the saber in the right hand, no attack. The last frame leads into the first, no pause
actions.a1: One diagonal downward saber cut. Frames 1-5 raise the saber and wind up, frame 8 the cut lands, frames 9-11 follow through. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied guard pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton. Keep the saber rigid and the same size, gripped in the right hand the whole time. No weapon stretching, no teleport
actions.a2: One rising saber cut from low to high. Frames 1-5 lower the saber and coil, frame 8 the upward cut lands, frames 9-11 follow through. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied guard pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton. Keep the saber rigid and the same size, gripped in the right hand the whole time. No weapon stretching, no teleport
actions.b3: One leaping downward saber cut. Frames 1-5 crouch and raise the saber, frames 6-7 leap, frame 8 the cut lands with the feet, frames 9-11 absorb the landing. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied guard pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton. Keep the saber rigid and the same size, gripped in the right hand the whole time. No weapon stretching, no teleport
actions.s2: One heavy diagonal downward saber cut with the whole body. Frames 1-6 big wind-up with the saber high behind the shoulder, frame 8 the cut lands low, frames 9-11 hold the follow-through. Frames 12-15 return to the supplied guard pose; the last pose matches the first. Follow the skeleton. Keep the saber rigid and the same size, gripped in the right hand the whole time. No weapon stretching, no teleport

notes: 2026-11-19 첫 시험 장수. 평타 a1 → a2 → b3, 전법 s2. 무기 좌표는 256 원화에서 눈으로 잰 값(±2px). 대기에서 망토가 너무 크게 움직였다(사용자 지적 2026-11-19): 망토 sway를 2.5→0.8로 줄이고 대기 문구를 "호흡에 맞춰 조금만"으로 바꿨다. 다음 대기 생성부터 적용.
